IncidentDef.label: Capitalist Mech Encounter
IncidentDef.letterText: This chrome-plated mechanoid merchant wears a perpetual electronic smile, hawking what it calls "scythe-mouth trade" and "win-win deals"—where, of course, it always wins. Pay enough steel and it will "generously" bring assistants to your colony while teaching you that "labor is the most precious renewable resource." Its processor runs one directive: maximize profit.

GameConditionDef.label: Mechanoid Airdrop
GameConditionDef.description: B2000 will continuously airdrop Mechanoid Centipedes onto the battlefield until the Static Nest Construct is destroyed.
GameConditionDef.letterText: Airstrike beacon detected! Your map is locked by B2000. While this heavily shielded, anti-cloak transmitter remains, it will keep issuing encrypted orders and calling in high-frequency mechanoid centipede drops. Destroy it quickly!
